trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with a wide vertex angle of approximately 140-150 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the overall lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge displays irregular micro-serrations with low pixel amplitude; localized clusters of sharper peaks are evident near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins of both lobes follow a convex mathematical curve, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white and beige pixel rosettes concentrated at the distal tips of both fluke lobes and the apex of the visible pectoral fin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the dark dorsal surface of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (high-contrast circular clusters) on the trailing edges and pectoral fin tip; minor surface pitting on the dorsal fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A single pectoral fin is oriented vertically out of the water to the left of the fluke, displaying a high-contrast white ventral surface with a dark leading edge.
